app: Foil 1.14.2 (build 51), Debug, ad hoc signed, isolated acceptance state

maximum_rule_ui.original_stack_sample: An 8-second sample captured 1,944 main-thread samples in AppState.saveLocalCorrections, 1,937 in LocalCorrectionEngine.compile, and 1,919 in LocalCorrectionEngine.validate, repeatedly normalizing aliases in pairwise comparison.
maximum_rule_ui.preview_at_limit: ask cloud code -> ask Claude Code; 1 replacement
maximum_rule_ui.relaunch: Foil reopened with the remaining vocabulary rule Off, the edited/deleted rule absent, and the stored rule counts unchanged.
maximum_rule_ui.app_result: No crash, hang, or visible multi-second stall after indexed alias validation.

automation_note: Two ad hoc signed XCUITest attempts timed out while enabling automation mode before entering the test body; the direct UI run above exercised the same real controls instead. The temporary launch and test helpers were removed from the final source diff.
